idea-plugin.name: MavenUp
idea-plugin.description:
Find and fix vulnerable Maven dependencies — and keep every dependency, plugin, and parent POM up to date from one tool window.

Core Features:

  • Vulnerability Scanning: Check your dependencies, plugins, and resolved transitive components for known vulnerabilities via OSV.dev and Sonatype OSS Index, with severity, CVSS score, and affected versions shown right in the table, and discreet hints confirming a scan without findings.
  • One-Click Vulnerability Fixes: Apply the recommended fix version — the lowest release that resolves every known finding of a component — for a single entry or for all affected entries at once, and pin vulnerable transitive dependencies in dependencyManagement with configurable explanatory comments without editing the pom.xml by hand.
  • Find & Update Versions: Discover newer versions in Maven Central and private repositories — automatically after each project load and Maven resync — then apply a configurable auto-selection strategy (disabled, highest version, or latest minor in the current major line), bulk-select the highest major, highest minor, recommended fix, or current version for all dependencies at once, or set those versions—or reset to the current version—for a single dependency straight from its row context menu.
  • Complete Dependency Overview: Displays all dependencies, plugins, and parent POM across Maven modules in an organized table, marking entries whose version is inherited from the parent POM or an imported BOM with an (inherited) label.
  • Status at a Glance: Marks the tool window icon with a colored badge dot — red for high or critical vulnerabilities, yellow for lower-severity findings, blue when only newer versions are available — so the state stays visible while the tool window is collapsed.
  • Smart Navigation: Jump directly to pom.xml definitions — or to the version property definition when clicking the Property column — and open artifacts in Maven repository browsers with a single click.

Advanced Capabilities:

  • Property-Aware Versions: Recognizes and updates Maven properties (e.g., ${spring.version}) across all references.
  • Flexible Filtering & Sorting: Filter by name, type, inherited or declared version, pending changes, available updates, or security findings—including whether a dependency is affected itself or only through its transitive dependencies—quickly filter by a right-clicked GroupId, ArtifactId, or Property via the row context menu, clear every filter with a single reset button, and sort any column ascending, descending, or back to the original pom.xml order to quickly locate the dependencies you need.
  • Optional Downgrades: Enable an "offer all versions" setting to also list versions older than the current one when a rollback is needed; the current version and the recommended fix version are marked in the selection dropdown.
  • Repository Browser Options: Choose between MVN Repository and Sonatype Central for artifact links.
  • Private GroupId Filter: Configure a comma-separated list of private/internal GroupId prefixes to exclude matching dependencies, plugins, managed dependencies/plugins, and parent POMs from queries to Maven Central, so no company information is transmitted to that external server.
  • Private Repository Support: Access authenticated repositories from settings.xml with fallback to standard Maven user settings.
  • Detailed Security Reports: View advisories in a master-detail split view with an origin column that classifies each finding as direct or transitive, plus severity, CVSS scores and vector, CWE identifiers, publish/last-modified dates, summaries, detailed descriptions, affected version ranges, fixed-in versions, references, and a link to open the affected component in the configured repository browser, with the severity column color-coded to match the tool window.
  • Safe Update Workflow: Review every planned change in a sortable confirmation dialog before it is written to the pom.xml files, and optionally trigger the IDE's Maven sync right afterwards.
  • Transitive Vulnerabilities View: A dedicated Transitive CVEs tool window tab lists all transitive dependencies with known vulnerabilities, including type, vulnerability count, and an editable new-version column that highlights the recommended fix in the dropdown; narrow the list with its own filter row, select the highest major, highest minor, or recommended fix version—for all visible coordinates via the toolbar or a single one via its row context menu—and reset selections.
  • Secure Token Storage: API tokens are stored safely in IntelliJ Password Safe.
  • Global Settings: Configure behavior, filters, and integrations under Settings | Tools | MavenUp to apply across all projects.
  • Responsive UI & Restart-Free: Background processing and dynamic loading ensure smooth operation and updates without IDE restart.
  • Privacy-First Design: Only Maven coordinates are transmitted for version checks and vulnerability scans—your source code remains private.
